title: Nick Bosa hopes to play with "no reservations" against Rams

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Nick Bosa hopes to play with "no reservations" against Rams
sources.description: The 49ers have already revealed that defensive end Nick Bosa will be playing against the Rams on Thursday, which means the biggest question left about his return to action after last year's torn ACL is how much he'll be on the field.
